title: Finch Circle Rush Fee Waiver Amount — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Member Benefits Ledger Note
content:
**Clause.** On a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, the Finch Circle rush fee waiver is worked out as follows.

1. **Rush fee standing.** The rush fee standing is the total of the rush fee charges booked on the ticket.
2. **Class.** No Finch Circle rush fee waiver is owed in a service class whose figure for "a Finch Circle tier's waived-rush-fee benefit waives this class's rush fee" is not "yes"; in such a class the waiver is nil.
3. **Tier.** The member's tier is the tier the active Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership holds when the waiver is booked.
4. **Assembly from the waiver form.** The rush fee waiver is assembled from its form:
   - under the co-pay form it is the rush fee standing less the member rush co-pay, never below zero, raised by the tenure and points reliefs added together (each relief being a percentage of that amount);
   - under the per-operation form it is 8.00 USD for each operation charge on the ticket;
   - under the standard method it is the whole rush fee standing for an active Finch Circle member whose tier carries the waived rush alteration fee benefit, and nothing for anyone else.
5. **Limit and rounding.** The waiver is never more than the rush fee standing, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, on that final figure — a figure at or above the half-cent mark, or within 0.0001 of a cent below it, going up to the next cent.

On this computation the waiver takes the standard method: an active member whose tier carries the waived rush alteration fee benefit has the whole rush fee standing waived, and anyone else has nothing waived.

## Assembly, worked (hypothetical figures)

| Form | Figures | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| co-pay | rush fee 60.00 USD, co-pay taken as 35.00 USD, reliefs adding to 15 percent | 25.00 USD raised by 15 percent: 28.75 USD |
| co-pay | rush fee 25.00 USD, co-pay taken as 35.00 USD | nil (never below zero) |
| per-operation | rush fee 37.80 USD, 3 operation charges | 24.00 USD |
| per-operation | rush fee 37.80 USD, 6 operation charges (48.00 USD) | 37.80 USD (never more than the rush fee standing) |
| standard | rush fee 37.80 USD, member whose tier carries the benefit | 37.80 USD |
| standard | rush fee 37.80 USD, no active membership | nil |

In a class whose figure is "not applicable", every row gives nil.
